_note: Enemy variety (D495, D560, D652): sizes and elites per kind, the shield-bearer. Read by Scripts/Gameplay/EnemyVariety.gd. A bigger enemy is its own kind with its own art, and those kinds are the elites (D652): no scaled 'large', no outline. XP stays 1.0: the D297 curve puts level 5 on the last City Gates kill with 15 XP to spare.

levels._note: D642: a fight's enemy_level (RoomEnemySpawner) is the level the hero reaches it at; health[level - 1] and damage[level - 1] multiply the enemy's HP and damage. They follow the SKILLS hero of verify_difficulty: HP with his weapon hits and skills, damage with his HP and armour (the City gear lands at level 5). XP does not grow (D297).

pressure._note: D642: how many enemies may wind up at once (EnemyLogic attack token, D576 had 2).

elite._note: D560's multipliers, only for kinds with "elite": true (D652). D754: poise multiplies the kind's poise (a light combo does not break an elite), and an elite is not pushed by the hero's hits, like a boss (B134).

kinds._note: A kind spawns once its sheet exists (EnemyVariety.available). sizes: weights of the seeded roll in ordinary fights (RoomEnemySpawner.respawns); story fights take medium. A big kind (base = the ordinary kind it stands in for) has no art yet: its spawn point (EnemySpawnPoint.big_kind, a node named BigSlot_*) spawns the base kind until the sheet lands; then the kind needs its scene and Resources/Enemies/enemy_stats_<kind>.tres (verify_enemy_variety checks). foam: the cursed foam effect at the mouth (D653), frame pixels from the frame centre, facing right (jackal_cursed: its own 96x72 frames, the jaws of idle, walk and the bite).
